title: Tauri desktop app removed
summary: The Tauri desktop app (.dmg/.msi/.AppImage) is discontinued. Use vcad.io in the browser, or the native SwiftUI Mac app in apple/VcadApp on macOS.

breaking.description: No more desktop installers or auto-updates. Desktop-only features are gone: native menus, context menus, file dialogs and recent files, OS notifications, the vcad:// deep links and desktop magic-link sign-in, and the built-in Bambu printer bridge.
breaking.migration: Use https://vcad.io (printing works through the local relay at 127.0.0.1:7878) or build apple/VcadApp with build-ffi.sh and bundle.sh.
